workload: two hosts concurrently update one 4KiB file, flock + fsync, 100 increments each
start_barrier: Both remote workers READY before GO on their stdin
worker_code_template:
import fcntl,json,os,sys,time
from datetime import datetime,timezone
print('READY',flush=True)
assert sys.stdin.readline().strip()=='GO'
started_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
start=time.monotonic()
lock_waits=[]
io_durations=[]
with open('/mnt/nfs-block/shared-counter-20260930-repeat.bin','r+b',buffering=0) as f:
 for i in range(100):
  lock_start=time.monotonic()
  fcntl.flock(f,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
  lock_waits.append(time.monotonic()-lock_start)
  io_start=time.monotonic()
  f.seek(0);data=f.read(4096)
  assert len(data)==4096 and data[10:]==b'X'*4086
  value=int(data[:10])+1
  f.seek(0);assert f.write(f"{value:010d}".encode()+b'X'*4086)==4096
  os.fsync(f.fileno())
  io_durations.append(time.monotonic()-io_start)
  fcntl.flock(f,fcntl.LOCK_UN)
  time.sleep(0.005)
print(json.dumps({'increments':100,'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-start,3),'started_utc':started_utc,'finished_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'max_lock_wait_seconds':round(max(lock_waits),6),'max_io_seconds':round(max(io_durations),6),'lock_waits_over_one_second':[{'iteration':i,'seconds':round(t,6)} for i,t in enumerate(lock_waits) if t>1]}))
